title: convert.cancel
description: Asks the engine to stop the in-flight call with the given id. It is handled while that call is still running, so the engine reads stdin on a separate thread. Cancellation takes effect between stages and between llama-server requests; the cancelled call then answers with CANCELLED. This method itself answers at once.

cancelled.description: False when no call with that id was in flight (it may have just finished). Not an error.
